key: Sorry, admittance to the apartments is for tenants only.
en: Sorry, admittance to the apartments is for tenants only.
ja: すみません　この住宅への立ち入りは　入居者の方のみです

key: Some 'dem folks is annoyin', always leavin' the gate to the rooftop garden open... Dangnabbit.
en: Some 'dem folks is annoyin', always leavin' the gate to the rooftop garden open... Dangnabbit.
ja: まったく　屋上庭園の門を　開けっぱなしにする連中が　いてこまるわい……

key: Boy howdy, lemme tell you I used to be ravin' something fierce about these tyke kids always lettin' strangers upside onto our roof.
en: Boy howdy, lemme tell you I used to be ravin' something fierce about these tyke kids always lettin' strangers upside onto our roof.
ja: いやはや　昔は　ガキどもが　よそ者を屋上に上げるたび　えらい剣幕で　どなっとったもんじゃ

key: But butter my butt and call me a biscuit, it turn out they done some good!
en: But butter my butt and call me a biscuit, it turn out they done some good!
ja: ところがどっこい　あいつら　いいことも　しとったんじゃ!

key: All them community folks what were hangin' up on the roof decided they'd pitch and make it three steps brighter, and you should see the place now!
en: All them community folks what were hangin' up on the roof decided they'd pitch and make it three steps brighter, and you should see the place now!
ja: 屋上に集まっとった連中が　力を合わせて　三倍も明るい場所に　してくれてなあ! 今の屋上を　見てみい!

key: That'll teach me to shut ourselves up again.
en: That'll teach me to shut ourselves up again.
ja: もう二度と　心を閉ざすまいと　思い知らされたわい

key: SKYE: Oh, hey, you're the one from school.
en: SKYE: Oh, hey, you're the one from school.
ja: スカイ: ああ　学校にいた　やつだな

key: Look, don't take it personally, man, but I gotta stay on Fern's good side.
en: Look, don't take it personally, man, but I gotta stay on Fern's good side.
ja: なあ　悪く思わないでくれよ　オレは　ファーンに　にらまれたくないんだ

key: Well, so much for that, huh?
en: Well, so much for that, huh?
ja: まあ　その話も　もう　おしまいだけどな

key: I'll make it up to you though. This is my place. This door? Goes up to the rooftop garden.
en: I'll make it up to you though. This is my place. This door? Goes up to the rooftop garden.
ja: せめてもの　おわびだ。ここが　オレの家でさ。このドアは　屋上庭園に　つながってる

key: It's pretty nice up there. Feel free to check it out.
en: It's pretty nice up there. Feel free to check it out.
ja: なかなか　いい場所だぜ。好きに　のぞいてみなよ

key: SKYE: Oh, hey, you're the one everyone's been talking about!
en: SKYE: Oh, hey, you're the one everyone's been talking about!
ja: スカイ: おっ　みんなが　うわさしてる　やつだな!

key: Look, I'm sorry about before. I got caught up with Fern, and well, I guess we both know now that wasn't too hot of a decision.
en: Look, I'm sorry about before. I got caught up with Fern, and well, I guess we both know now that wasn't too hot of a decision.
ja: なあ　この前は　悪かった。ファーンに　流されちまってさ。いい判断じゃなかったのは　おたがい　わかってるよな

key: SKYE: This door goes up to the rooftop garden.
en: SKYE: This door goes up to the rooftop garden.
ja: スカイ: このドアは　屋上庭園に　つながってるぜ

key: Heya. Can I ask ya something?
en: Heya. Can I ask ya something?
ja: よう。ちいと　聞いてもええかね?

key: A friend of mine recently was down at the Day Care in the Obsidia Ward and he said the folks there were acting mighty strange.
en: A friend of mine recently was down at the Day Care in the Obsidia Ward and he said the folks there were acting mighty strange.
ja: ダチが　このまえ　オブシディアワードの育て屋に　行ったんじゃが　そこの連中のようすが　えらく　おかしかったそうでな

key: I dunno what that is, but you know anything about it?
en: I dunno what that is, but you know anything about it?
ja: わしには　さっぱりじゃが　あんた　なにか知らんかね?

key: He said they always used to be real friendly, but something's been wrong lately.
en: He said they always used to be real friendly, but something's been wrong lately.
ja: 昔は　ずいぶん親切だったのに　最近は　どうも　おかしいらしい

key: I'll tell you what though, if you get a chance, I'd ask you to go down there and shake some sense into 'em.
en: I'll tell you what though, if you get a chance, I'd ask you to go down there and shake some sense into 'em.
ja: もし　機会があったらでいい　あそこへ行って　連中の目を　覚まさせてやってくれんかね

key: I've been tellin' a lotta people that though and I don't think anyone's done it yet, so...
en: I've been tellin' a lotta people that though and I don't think anyone's done it yet, so...
ja: まあ　あちこちで　同じことを　たのんどるが　まだ誰も　やっとらんようでな……

key: I'd thank ya kindly if'n you could.
en: I'd thank ya kindly if'n you could.
ja: やってくれたら　ありがたいんじゃがな

key: I been tellin' a lotta people that though and I don't think anyone's done it yet, so...
en: I been tellin' a lotta people that though and I don't think anyone's done it yet, so...
ja: あちこちで　同じことを　たのんどるが　まだ誰も　やっとらんようでな……

key: I'd thank ya kindly if you could.
en: I'd thank ya kindly if you could.
ja: やってくれたら　ありがたいんじゃが

key: Huh, you mean you actually did go down and have a word with 'em?
en: Huh, you mean you actually did go down and have a word with 'em?
ja: ほう　本当に　あそこへ行って　話を　つけてくれたんかね?

key: They was fakes all along? Golly!
en: They was fakes all along? Golly!
ja: あいつら　最初から　ニセモノだったと? たまげたわい!

key: Well, hey, I super appreciate you checkin' out that situation. 'Bout time someone done it.
en: Well, hey, I super appreciate you checkin' out that situation. 'Bout time someone done it.
ja: いやはや　調べてくれて　本当に助かったわい。誰かが　やるべきだったんじゃ

key: Lemme give you this little guy as a thank-ya. He ain't hatched yet, but you might think he's cute when he finally do.
en: Lemme give you this little guy as a thank-ya. He ain't hatched yet, but you might think he's cute when he finally do.
ja: お礼に　このちびすけを　やろう。まだ　かえっとらんが　生まれたら　かわいいと　思うはずじゃ

key: \PN got an Egg!
en: \PN got an Egg!
ja: \PNは　タマゴを　もらった!

key: Take care now, y'hear?
en: Take care now, y'hear?
ja: 達者でな　いいかね?
